abstract: Seventy-three patients with seminoma testis stage II have been retrospectively analyzed with regard to prognostic factors and value of prophylactic mediastinal irradiation and chemotherapy. Although survival differences were seen between stage IIa, IIb and IIc, these were not statistically significant. Neither was there a significant difference between IIc patients with tumors greater than 10 cm and less than 10 cm in diameter. The incidence of HCG-producing seminomas in the present series was 16%. No significant difference in survival nor relapse rate was found between HCG-producing and HCG-non-producing seminomas. Prophylactic mediastinal irradiation did not influence the survival nor the relapse rate and may therefore be omitted. In the present series there was no significant improvement neither in relapse rate nor survival in patients receiving pre-irradiation chemotherapy. However, the total number of patients is small and optimal pre-irradiation chemotherapy still have to be defined.
abstract_ja: 病期IIの精巣セミノーマ患者73例を後方視的に解析し、予後因子ならびに予防的縦隔照射と化学療法の意義を検討した。IIa、IIb、IIcの各病期間で生存率に差が認められたが、統計学的な有意差はなかった。IIc症例では腫瘍径10cmを超える群と未満の群の間にも有意差はなかった。hCG産生セミノーマは本シリーズの16%を占めたが、hCG非産生セミノーマとの間で生存率や再発率に有意差は認められなかった。予防的縦隔照射は生存率も再発率も変えなかったため、省略してよいと考えられる。照射前化学療法によって再発率や生存率が有意に改善することもなかった。ただし症例数が少ないため、最適な照射前化学療法はまだ定義されていない。
